POST /api/v1/access/requests: Any signed-in caller may ask for access for themselves; reviewing or closing a request is granted separately.
POST /api/v1/auth/device-login/approve: A passkey assertion approves the caller's own login.
POST /api/v1/auth/device-login/approve-s: The authenticated caller approves their own desktop login.
POST /api/v1/auth/device-login/poll: The one-use poll token consumes the caller's own login handoff.
POST /api/v1/auth/device-login/start: Public login starts without a role grant.
POST /api/v1/auth/logout: A caller may end their own session without a role grant.
POST /api/v1/auth/otp/redeem: A one-time code authenticates its holder without a role grant.
POST /api/v1/auth/passkey/enroll-handoff: The caller enrolls a device for their own account.
POST /api/v1/auth/passkey/login/finish: A passkey assertion authenticates without a role grant.
POST /api/v1/auth/passkey/login/start: Public login starts without a role grant.
POST /api/v1/auth/passkey/register/finis: The caller registers their own passkey.
POST /api/v1/auth/passkey/register/start: The caller starts registration of their own passkey.
POST /api/v1/auth/passkey/step-up/start: The caller proves their own identity; this grants no command authority.
DELETE /api/v1/auth/passkeys/{id}: A caller may revoke their own non-final passkey.
PATCH /api/v1/auth/passkeys/{id}: A caller may rename their own passkey.
POST /api/v1/auth/privacy-consent/accept: The caller accepts their own required privacy terms.
POST /api/v1/auth/privacy-consent/status: The caller reads their own consent state through the authentication protocol.
POST /api/v1/auth/signup: Public signup creates a lowest-privilege account without a role grant.
POST /api/v1/auth/token/refresh: A refresh token rotates its own session without a role grant.
POST /api/v1/client-errors: The public same-origin error beacon reports client failures.
PATCH /api/v1/users/me: The caller edits their own display name and phone.
PUT /api/v1/me/workspace: The caller stores their own workspace layout.
POST /api/v1/me/inbox-docs/{id}/confirm-: The caller confirms their own legal notice with a fresh passkey assertion.
DELETE /api/v1/me/notification-policies/: The caller removes their own notification mute policy.
PUT /api/v1/me/notification-policies: The caller changes their own notification mute policy.
POST /api/v1/me/notifications/read-all: The caller marks their own notifications as read.
POST /api/v1/me/notifications/{id}/read: The caller marks their own notification as read.
POST /api/v1/me/notifications/{id}/unrea: The caller marks their own notification as unread.
POST /api/v1/me/todos: The caller creates a todo owned by the authenticated account.
DELETE /api/v1/me/todos/{todoId}: The caller removes their own todo.
POST /api/v1/me/todos/{todoId}/done: The caller marks their own todo done or undone.
